info.title: cap-event API Gateway
info.description: Public HTTP surface for cap-event: a fake OneLogin (OIDC, Authorization Code + PKCE) a spotify-style JSON auth API, and the reference-data / cap-event-package routes the UI calls (derived from the OpenAPI specs in contracts/openapi). This document is the contract for the UI.

access_token.description: HS256 JWT with sub, email, name claims

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single-use; rotated on every refresh

id_token.description: HS256 JWT with sub, email, name, aud, iss

example: email - Should be a valid email address

redirect_uri.description: authorization_code grant: must equal the redirect_uri of the auth request

refresh_token.description: refresh_token grant: the current refresh token

access_token.description: HS256 JWT with sub, email, name claims

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single-use; rotated on every refresh

id_token.description: HS256 JWT with sub, email, name, aud, iss

error_description.example: Authorization code is invalid or expired

title.description: Full descriptive title of the investment

allocationBasisId.description: Not in the schema, but used by the spec example; preferred when present

lineItem.description: Aggregated line item; its investor entries must belong to one investor
